# Specimen set API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Tissue or cultures prepared together, such as a slice series or a well plate, usually taken from a subject.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimenset/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/specimenset/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `specimenset` (detail, create, update), `specimensets` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [SpecimenSet type](/api/schemas/specimenset/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/), [`specimen`](/api/stem/specimen/), [`specimenlog`](/api/modules/specimenlog/), [`specimenprocedure`](/api/modules/specimenprocedure/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `type` | one of the [SpecimenSet types](/api/schemas/specimenset/) **[required]** |
| `baseline_conditions` | JSON object. Processing the material had already undergone when this set was created, for example fixed by perfusion before extraction. |
| `preparation_conditions` | JSON object **[read-only]** |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `available`, `in_use`, `reserved`, `consumed`, `discarded`, `lost` **[required]**. Current availability status of this specimen set. |
| `quality` | one of `excellent`, `good`, `fair`, `poor`, `not_assessed`. Overall quality assessment for this specimen set. |
| `item_count` | number; nullable. Total number of items in the set. Useful when individual specimens are not tracked. |
| `subject` | [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) id; nullable; nestable. Subject this specimen set was derived from, if applicable. |
| `source_specimen_set` | [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) id; nullable; nestable. Specimen set this set was derived from. |
| `projects` | list of [`project`](/api/stem/project/) ids **[required]**; nestable |
| `target_regions` | list of [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) ids |
| `preparation_datetime` | datetime; nullable. Date and time when this specimen set was prepared. |
| `termination_datetime` | datetime; nullable. Date and time when this specimen set was consumed, discarded, or otherwise terminated. |
| `storage_location` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Current physical storage location, container, or slot. |
| `storage_conditions` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Current storage conditions, such as temperature and medium. |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `extra_content_json` | JSON object; nullable |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `tags` | list of strings; filter with `filter{tags.name}=<name>` |
| `specimenprocedures` | list of [`specimenprocedure`](/api/modules/specimenprocedure/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `specimenlogs` | list of [`specimenlog`](/api/modules/specimenlog/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimenset/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('specimenset', load_all=True)
records = resp['specimensets']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('specimenset', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.specimensets;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimenset/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimenset', data={"name": "Specimen set 1", "type": "Array", "status": "available", "projects": ["<project-id>"], "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}})
record = resp.json()['specimenset']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Specimen set 1', 'type', 'Array', 'status', 'available', 'projects', {{'<project-id>'}}, 'details', struct()), 'specimenset');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.specimenset;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimenset/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimenset', id='<id>', data={"name": "Specimen set 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Specimen set 1 (renamed)'), 'specimenset', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimenset/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('specimenset', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'specimenset');
```

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Specimen set data model page](/datamodel/stem/specimenset/).
